buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) SCOPE OF WORK: As mentioned in Scope of work Cum Price Bid Format enclosed as Annexure- VII and includes the following: a) Non- technical maintenance of following HEMMs: SL.NO Description of job UNIT QTY. Non-technical maintenance excavat 1 Nos. 24 or. Non-technical maintenance Backho 2 Nos. 24 e 3 Non-technical maintenance Drill Nos. 32 4 Non-technical maintenance Dozer Nos. 24 5 Non-technical maintenance Dumper Nos. 15 Non-technical maintenance water ta 6 Nos. 6 nker (28 kl) Non-technical maintenance Motor g 7 Nos. 6 rader Non-technical maintenance Tyre ha 8 Nos. 2 ndler b) The contractor must arrange truck mounted mobile high pressure cold washing jet e quipment with minimum water tanker of capacity 1.5 KL for cleaning of Heavy Earth M oving Machinery at Mines. c) Water will be provided by SAIL at its available sources. d) The contractor shall use diesel-powered high-pressure machine of 250-300 bar with adjustable pressure and water flow of 650 LPH to 1300 LPH, so that HEMMs at mining places can be washed properly, where electricity is not available.

e) The contractor shall use flexible hose – 30 meters and all three-different type of nozz les (short distance jet, long distance jet and spay washing) for different requirement. f) The equipment for pressure washing shall be of branded make like Karcher/ Power fl ush/Mist jet for proper/safe washing. g) The washing facility must be capable of normal cold pressure water cleaning, foam c leaning, cleaning of mud stuck between track chains of shovel, drill etc by high pressure jet. h) The contractor should use Biodegradable cleaning agent with Foam for prope r cleaning (all spot, grease and strain to be completely removed from the bo dy of machine) of HEMMs at Site Supply of cleaning agent will be in vendor’s scop e, but this should be approved by SAIL. i) The radiator and oil cooler to be cleaned using biodegradable solutions like Rydall CC for effective fins cleaning, Rydall CC supply will be under vendor’s scope. j) Vacuum Cleaner should be used for cabin cleaning. k) The contractor shall use cloths for cleaning purposes, and the use of jute or cotton w aste is strictly prohibited. l) Vehicle should be BS VI OBD 2 class or its Equivalent is only acceptable and Vehicle age should not be more than 3 years during in point of time in contract. m) The contractor should regularly contact the executing authority for inspection and en gage his personnel in day time (6:00 AM to 6:00 PM) for work whenever advised. n) The job will be on throughout the contract period as per requirement of SAIL, MIOM, o) The contractor should deploy stand-by unit in case of brake down of high-pressure je t vehicle. p) The contractor should always depute one supervisor at site with the instruction book for necessary job co-ordination with executing authority. q) The contractor shall use own tools, tackles, and safety appliances and provide traini ng to his person required for the job. r) The contractor should maintain good housekeeping before and after finishing their jo b. No spillage of oil and grease will be allowed at site while / after the cleani ng jobs. Vendor must clear if any spillage of oil or grease at ground. s) During Washing of Radiator & Oil Cooler of any HEMM suitable pressure & suitable n ozzle should be used, Vendor will be responsible for damage of any radiator/oil cooler fins during washing. Cost of damage will be recovered from the bill of the Vendor. t) Weekly schedule will be given to party by Executing authority/his representative.
